block.label: ROLE-PLAY · WHO ATE THE CHOCOLATE?
block.html: Last night, somebody ate the big chocolate bar that was in the kitchen. The teacher is the detective. Each sister tells her story. Is there a contradiction? Who is guilty?

roles.name: Isabel
roles.card: Invent your alibi: Where were you at 9 p.m.? What were you doing? Who was with you? What was the cat (or dog) doing? Answer every question with details, and don't change your story!

roles.name: Larissa
roles.card: Invent your alibi too: Where were you at 9 p.m.? What were you doing? What did you hear? What was your sister doing? You can try to blame your sister... but be careful!

roles.name: Detective (teacher)
roles.card: Ask each sister separately: Where were you at 9? What were you doing? What was your sister doing? What did you see or hear? Did you go to the kitchen? Look for contradictions and decide who is guilty.

block.label: GAME · INVENT A BRAND
block.html: Draw a product and a challenge. Invent a brand: its name, its logo and its colors. Then present it to the teacher like on TV! Your sister asks two questions.
lines: a backpack that cleans your room
prompts: how you invented it (in the past)
what the product is doing right now in a store
why it is better than other brands
